primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 本文でこの人物の名または明確な同一人物への言及を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

wikipediaRead.title: Jehoram
wikipediaRead.locator: L108–113: list distinguishes Jehoram of Judah, Jehoram of Israel, and a priest sent by Jehoshaphat to instruct people (2 Chronicles 17:8).
wikipediaRead.supportParaphraseJa: 英語版の同名人物一覧は、歴代誌下17:8のヨラムを、ユダの王や別のヨラムと分けて祭司として挙げています。
wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: L108–113: list distinguishes Jehoram of Judah, Jehoram of Israel, and a priest sent by Jehoshaphat to instruct people (2 Chronicles 17:8).

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 本文がこの名を直接挙げるか、同じ節で明確に同一人物を指します。

sourceReuse: Fixed WEB verses were read from the pinned local 2CH witness; article-body reads are recorded per linked profile.
authorRepairDecisionJa: 2歴代誌17:8はエリシャマとヨラムを祭司として列挙する。教える働きは次節17:9なので、初出欄からその先取りを除いた。
